evidence.text: The facility features double-walled, titanium-tubed condensers to condense and recover the steam passing through the turbines. Management of spent fuel and waste from the Koeberg NPP The spent fuel of the Koeberg NPP is stored in high-density storage racks in spent fuel pools on-site, while the low and intermediate level waste from the facility is transported in steel containers to a remote disposal site at Vaalputs in the Kalahari Desert, located approximately 600km north of Cape Town. The Vaalputs waste repository is operated by the South African Nuclear Energy Corporation (Necsa), on behalf of the National Radioactive Waste Disposal Institute (NRWDI). Power transmission from Koeberg The electricity generated by the Koeberg nuclear power station is evacuated into the South African grid through a 400kV transmission line.
